content: Koyro Yelettida Addey Wuri Godaas Dummateth
GODAY Muse hizgides,
«Adde gidi koyro yelettida ubbaa taas dummasa. Isra7eele asaa giddon koyro yelettida bayray wuri mehe gidiin as gidiin wurikka taassa.»

Hessafe guye Musey asaa, «Gibxeppe, aylleteththa biittafe intte kezida gallassaya hanno gallassayo gididayssa yuushshi qoppite; ays giikko GODAY ba wolqqama qesen inttena kessides; hessa gishshas irshoy gelida kath aykkoka moopite.
Intte ha gallassayn Abibe geetettiza aginan kezideta.

GODAY Kanaaneta, Hiiteta, Amooreta, Hiiwetanne Yaabuseta geetettiza dereta biittaa inttena gaththiza wode intte ha bonchcho gallassaa ha aginan bonchcheeta. He biittay GODAY inttes immana mala kase intte aawatas caaqqi woththida biitta. He biittay maaththinne eessi goggiza biitta.
Intte laappun gallas irshoy gelontta uketh maana; laappunththa gallas GODAAS ba7aale histti bonchcheeta.
He laappun gallassatan irshoy gelontta uketh intte maana; intte giddon irshora dizay aykkoyka beettofo; ne biitta zawan awankka irshoy mulekka dooppo.
«He gallas neni ne naytas, ‹Tani hayssa ooththizay tani Gibxeppe keziza wode GODAY taas ooththidayssa zaari qoppanaassa› ga yoota.

GODAY inttena ba wolqqama kushen Gibxeppe kessida gishshas, GODAA wogay intte doonappe shaakettontta mala, hayssi ba7aalezi intte kushe bolla qashettidanne intte liiphen woththiin qofsiza miishsha mala gidana.
Hessa gishshas intte ha wogaa woththidi layththan layththan ha gallassan bonchchite.
«GODAY inttessinne kase intte aawatas immanaas caaqqida mala, izi inttena Kanaaneta biitta gelththidi, he biittaa inttes immiza wode,
attuma gidi yelettida bayra ubbaa GODAAS dummasite; ne mehe garsan adde gididi bayra yelettiday wuri GODAASSA.
Bayra yelettiza hare mar ubbaa laaqqara laammada wozza; laammada wozzontta ixxiko iza morgen shoca wodha. Ne nayta giddon attuma gidi bayra yelettidayta ubbaa wozza.
Wodeppe ne nay nena, ‹Hayssi aaza wogaa?› gi oychchiko, neni izas, ‹GODAY nuna ba wolqqama qesen aylleteththa biitta Gibxeppe kessides;

Gibxe kawoy ba wozina minththidi nuna yeddontta ixxiin GODAY Gibxe biittan diza bayra ubbaa, asappe doommidi mehe bayra gakkanaas wodhides. Tani aayi uloppe koyro yelettida adde mehe ubbaa GODAAS yarshizayssinne bayra gidida attuma nayta ubbaa wozzizayssi hessassa› ga.
GODAY nuna ba wolqqama qesen Gibxeppe kessidayssas, hayssi inttes kushen qachchida malatanne liiphe bolla woththida malata mala gidana» gides.
Goday Ba Asaa Kaaleththees
Kawoy asaa yeddida wode Xoossi istta Filisxeeme biittara kanththisiza ogey mata shin he ogezara efibeenna; gaasoykka Xoossi, «Asay ola beykko ba qofaa laammidi guye Gibxe simmanaakko» giidi qoppides.
Hessa gishshas Xoossi asaa bazzo ogera yuushshidi, Zo7o abbaako kaaleththides. Isra7eele asay Gibxe biittafe olas giigettida asa mala giigettidi Gibxeppe kezides.

Yooseefey Isra7eele asaa, «Xoossi tumappe inttena maaddana yaana; he wode intte ta meqeththaa hayssafe inttenara ekki biite» giidi caaqeththi woththida gishshas Musey iza meqeththaa banara ekki bides.
Istti Sukooteppe dendidi bazzo doonan diza Etaame geetettizason uttida.
Istti gallassika qammaka hemettana mala GODAY istta oge bessanaas tuussa mala eqqida shaaran gallas, tuussa mala eqqida taman omars istta kaaleththides.
Gallas tuussa mala eqqida shaaray, omars tuussa mala eqqida tamay asaa sinththafe ubba wode shaakettibeenna.
